notUsed.slash command: the older format: a skill runs by name the same way
notUsed.output style: one per session and it replaces the user's own style
notUsed.statusline: a plugin can ship only subagentStatusLine, and no need is a standing bar
notUsed.MCP server: the kit's own reads and writes go through scripts the shell gates and the approval ticket can check
notUsed.LSP server: reviewers read code with Read, Grep and git; no need is language diagnostics
notUsed.monitor: no need watches a long-running process; every kit check runs on an event
notUsed.workflow: kit steps wait on the user's answers between steps, and a workflow script runs to its end without them
notUsed.executable: scripts run by their plugin path through Bash, the form the gates match
notUsed.channel: no outside system sends messages into a session; the kit pulls on request
notUsed.mod: it changes the interface; the blocking point Claude Code documents is the PreToolUse hook
notUsed.model / effort pin: the user's settings remap aliases, so a pin needs its own eval; quota work decides it
notUsed.sandbox: a user setting that covers shell commands only, not their meaning (branch, profile path, publish target)
notUsed.settings: the kit writes only permission rules and an optional TEDY_PROFILE_DIR; no need is met by another key
notUsed.Agent SDK: nothing embeds the agent loop; evals drive claude -p as a subprocess
notUsed.advisor: a session choice of the user; a plugin cannot set it
notUsed.fast mode: a session choice of the user; a plugin cannot set it
notUsed.extended context: a session choice of the user; a plugin cannot set it

needs.need: role procedures (pm, dev, review-pr, reconcile, setup, learn, pending)

uses.skill: seven skills, loaded on match or by /tedy:<name>, with detail in references loaded on demand

rejected.subagent: a role asks the user between steps, and a subagent cannot call AskUserQuestion
rejected.hooks: a hook runs code on an event; it cannot carry a procedure
rejected.plugin eval: measures a skill, does not run one
rejected.permission rule: allows or blocks a tool call; carries no procedure
rejected.memory: always loaded; seven procedures on every turn would cost the context a skill loads only on use

uses.subagent: agents/reviewer.md: its own context and read-only tools, so a lens does not anchor on the caller's draft

rejected.skill: runs in the caller's context, which is the anchoring the lens must avoid
rejected.hooks: a hook cannot reason over a diff
rejected.permission rule: the reviewer's read-only scope is its tools list
rejected.memory: the lens instructions apply only when a review runs

needs.need: policy gates on tool calls (push and merge, role, profile writes, source comments, tracker token)

uses.hooks: PreToolUse on Bash, Edit, Write, Read, Grep and context-mode execute tools; exit 2 blocks the call

rejected.skill: instructions are advice; a gate must block
rejected.subagent: a gate must see the main session's calls
rejected.permission rule: patterns cannot read a command's meaning (branch, path, target), and a plugin cannot ship them

needs.need: publish approval bound to the user's answer

uses.hooks: PostToolUse on AskUserQuestion writes a one-use ticket each kit write script checks
uses.permission rule: ask or deny rules written to the user's settings by profile.mjs publish-approval after the user approves

rejected.skill: the skill asks, but a ticket must come from the answer itself
rejected.subagent: the answer is given in the main session

needs.need: report after a push (source comments, push target)

uses.hooks: PostToolUse on Bash and context-mode execute tools reads the pushed diff

rejected.skill: the push may come from any step, so a check tied to one skill would miss it
rejected.subagent: the report must follow the push in the same session
rejected.permission rule: runs before the call, and the report needs the pushed result

needs.need: continuity across sessions and compaction (pending hand-offs, active role)

uses.hooks: SessionStart startup and resume lists pending hand-offs; SessionStart compact restates the role

rejected.skill: loads only on match; the reminder must arrive unasked
rejected.subagent: its output would not reach the main context at start
rejected.memory: static text; the hand-off list is derived when the session starts

needs.need: nudge a prose question into AskUserQuestion

uses.hooks: Stop reads the last assistant message and returns a reason when it ends with a question

rejected.skill: advice the model already had when it wrote the question
rejected.subagent: would need the main message, which the Stop hook already receives
rejected.plugin eval: measures the rate (prose-question-rate.py), does not nudge
rejected.permission rule: the ending is text, not a tool call
rejected.memory: advice, not a check on the message

needs.need: tracker and host reads and writes (OpenProject, GitHub, Google Doc, Figma comments)

uses.skill: skills run node scripts under plugin/scripts through Bash, where the gates read the script name and each write checks the approval ticket

rejected.subagent: writes need the user's answer in the main session
rejected.hooks: a hook reacts to calls; it does not make them
rejected.permission rule: gates a call, does not make it

needs.need: measuring skills (behavior evals, pressure runs, probes)

uses.plugin eval: evals/<case> with graders and the no-plugin baseline; evals/pressure and evals/probes are custom harnesses beside it

rejected.subagent: runs in the session it would measure
rejected.hooks: observe one session, not a scored set

needs.need: the user's working style in every session (voice, ownership, approvals)

uses.memory: @<profile>/rules.md imported into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, added only after the user approves in /tedy:setup

rejected.skill: loads only on match; the style must hold on every turn
rejected.subagent: the style applies to the main session
